caption: A red and a blue spotlight are crossed on a white backdrop, and the area where they overlap glows purple.

sa.check: A red and a blue spotlight are crossed on a white backdrop.
The area where they overlap glows purple.
The single-colour areas stay red and blue.
The overlap disappears when one light is turned off.

pc.expect: The overlap is a different colour from either beam alone, and the single-colour areas stay red and blue.
pc.fail: The overlap is red or blue; or the single areas change colour; or the overlap is a colour unrelated to both.

pc.expect: The overlap exists only where both beams fall and would disappear if one light were turned off.
pc.fail: The purple area is outside both beams; or stays with one light off; or there is no overlap where the beams plainly cross.

pc.expect: The beams and the coloured areas do not move with the lights fixed.
pc.fail: An area drifts; or the beams swing; or the colours flicker.

pc.expect: Each beam is one soft-edged patch and the overlap is their intersection.
pc.fail: A beam splits; or the overlap is larger than either beam; or the patches are sharp squares.
A third light appears; or the backdrop vanishes; or a patch becomes solid.

pc.expect: The backdrop and the stage stay the same.
pc.fail: The backdrop changes shape; or the stage rearranges; or the lights change shape.
